name: g01-claw-left-index
description: finger_bones (per-joint), the shape the compact §5.5 block cannot reach: the left index proximal stays straight (identity) while the intermediate and distal bend 60 deg about -Z (into the palm). One curl byte per finger drives all three joints together, so this base-straight / outer-bent claw is only expressible per-joint. Quaternions are parent-relative, applied directly - no §5.5 synthesis. Cleared finger bits take the rest hand (spec §3.3, §5.5); only the three listed joints are posed here.
